title: Rust: GET /config/radio client
description: Acceptance: Rust client fetches radio config
close_reason: Implemented typed Rust GET /config/radio client with public RadioConfig/RadioConfigClient APIs and CONFIG_RADIO path. Decodes exactly one string-keyed CBOR map, exposes freq_mhz/bw_khz/sf/cr/tx_power_dbm/sync_word with strict wire types, preserves all extension values, rejects malformed/non-map/non-text-key/truncated/trailing payloads, and reports non-success CoAP responses. Consumes all canonical GET cases from lci_radio_config.json and includes UDP method/path/payload tests. Green: cargo test -p lichen-client --features tokio --locked (96 unit + 16 integration); clippy --lib -D warnings; no-default-features lib check; cargo fmt --check.
